decisions.reason: As a newly launched specialist product closely aligned with the firm's demanding-environment business, it is likely to be retained while management gives this niche offer more time under the firm's slack and long sales cycles.

Although a spring-balanced desk lamp is somewhat less central to the firm's strategic push than integrated intelligent lighting, its ergonomic office fit and dedicated product-page support make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

A general interior lighting luminaire is squarely in the firm's core business, and the 'G2' update signal suggests an ongoing platform rather than a tentative experiment, so aspiration shortfall concerns are low.

This pendant luminaire fits the firm's established application-focused interior portfolio, and a large incumbent would usually keep such a new core-category product on the market unless early evidence was clearly poor.

An HMI marine searchlight sits in a niche that is less consistent with the firm's stated move toward more sustainable LED-based solutions, so management is relatively more likely to redeploy resources if results are uncertain.

Marine searchlights match the firm's specialist-lighting capabilities and customer base in demanding environments, and with only a short time on the market the firm would typically continue before concluding they miss aspirations.
